thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: service=embed-canary-eu region=eu-west-1 — p99 embedding request 5xx rate = 2.7% over 5m. Alert window: 5m. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-4227

pd-bot: PagerDuty page fired to oncall (sara). Priority: P2 -> escalate if unacked for 5m.

sara: ack - I'm on it. pulling logs and dashboards.

mike: I see a spike in 503/504s on embed-worker-2 pods in eu-west-1, started ~10m after rollout. Error: OOM-ish GPU mem bump then 503. Which rollout?

deploy-bot: Rollout rl-2026-embed-v2 started 12m ago by ci/cd pipeline #rl-2026. Canary weight 10% initial.

sara: ok — reducing canary weight to limit blast radius. what's the quick command?

mike: run this to shift weight down quickly:

```
rctl rollout set-weight rl-2026-embed-v2 0.05 --region eu-west-1
```

sara: running now.

sara: :white_check_mark: set weight -> 0.05. watching metrics.

mike: logs show repeated "kernel_quant_alloc failed" entries and then GPU oom scheduling on specific shards. tagging eng-ml and eng-runtime.

ranjit: on ops duty — can we abort the canary and roll back to stable if weight change doesn't normalize within 5m? customer impact?

jessica: product: we are seeing customer error flags from AcmePay and Shoply in eu-west-1. Not yet escalated to P1 but both are watching. Need a short status for them.

sara: creating incident bridge.

sara: bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-4227 (joining).

ops-bot: Bridge created and recorded. Joining.

sara: after weight change, 5xx dropped from 2.7% -> 1.2% but baseline is 0.1% so still elevated.

mike: this smells like a memory leak with the new quantization kernel under certain sequence lengths — reproduction might be tied to long embeddings. I'd recommend aborting rollout for eu-west-1 now.

sara: propose rollback. Command to abort: 

```
rctl rollout abort rl-2026-embed-v2 --region eu-west-1
```

sara: executing abort now.

deploy-bot: Rollout abort requested by sara for rl-2026-embed-v2 in eu-west-1. Confirming...

sara: confirm. proceed.

deploy-bot: Rollout rl-2026-embed-v2 aborted in eu-west-1. Traffic routed back to stable model (embed-v1). :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: automated fallback completed: stable model restored in eu-west-1.

sara: metrics: p99 errors back to 0.12% within ~2m of abort. monitoring continues. :relieved:

jessica: product: I'm drafting a customer note to AcmePay/Shoply: brief description, mitigation taken (rollback), expectation that service restored, follow-up postmortem & timeline. Posting to #customer-notify shortly.

ranjit: ops: any sign of persistent state corruption or data loss?

mike: no evidence of data loss — only request failures (5xx). logs show kernel alloc failures then request aborts. we'll keep collecting traces.

sara: opening incident ticket INC-2026-embed-high-5xx and assigning eng-ml, eng-runtime, and platform oncall for follow-up.

sara: assigning to: mike, ranjit, emily, alex.

emily: ack — will reproduce locally against long-input repro and run mem profilers. I saw a smaller variant of this in staging last week but it didn't cross error thresholds.

sara: adding temporary alert suppression for rollout-induced pages in eu-west-1 to reduce noise while we investigate.

ops-bot: Alert suppression rule added (eu-west-1 rollout alerts) for 60m.

mike: logging a note of commands/timing for the postmortem: 

```
2026-03-15T01:24:22Z sara set-weight rl-2026-embed-v2 -> 0.05
2026-03-15T01:26:10Z sara abort rl-2026-embed-v2 (rollback to embed-v1)
```

sara: handing this to alex for overnight oncall. alex, please monitor bridge and metrics, keep an eye on embed-worker pods for OOM restarts.

alex: ack. I'll keep bridge open until 07:00 UTC, monitor p99, pod restart counts, and CPU/GPU mem. Adding runbook checklist to the ticket.

jessica: I'll coordinate customer comms tomorrow morning with timeline and next steps.

mike: creating a PR to revert the kernel change in rl-2026 and flagging it for a hotfix after the postmortem. Link to PR will go in the incident ticket.

sara: pd-bot — please keep incident open until postmortem exists and customers are notified.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: INC-4227 acknowledged by sara. Awaiting resolve after postmortem.

sara: resolving the active page since impact mitigated and rollback performed. Updating ticket with timeline and evidence.

pd-bot: Incident INC-4227 resolved by sara. Summary: Canary rl-2026-embed-v2 caused elevated 5xx in eu-west-1; weight reduced then aborted; rollback to embed-v1 restored normal metrics; affected customers informed; follow-up: revert quant kernel, postmortem and hotfix.

jessica: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. I'll post customer drafts and timeline in #customer-notify for review.

sara: adding final notes and will attach logs/trace links to the incident ticket. Good handoff.

ranjit: note to add model artifact hash and quant config in the PM.

end of thread.
